meta.description: Recruitment intelligence for football. Contextual percentiles measured against a stated peer group, role fits, statistical similarity and ranked shortlists - with the reasoning behind every result kept visible.

hero.title: Recruitment decisions need context, not just statistics.
hero.body: A scouting and market-analysis platform that turns raw match data into contextual percentiles, player roles, statistical similarity and ranked recruitment shortlists — with the reasoning behind every result kept visible.

principles.peerGroupTitle: Compared against the right peer group
principles.peerGroup: A centre-back's tackling means nothing measured against forwards. Every percentile is position-scoped and measured against an explicitly defined comparison population — one competition, a selected group of them, or a cross-competition recruitment pool — and which one is always shown alongside the number.
principles.explainable: A shortlist that cannot be interrogated is not useful to a recruitment department. Each ranked candidate exposes the component percentiles, weights and filters that produced its position.
principles.sample: A per-90 figure from 200 minutes looks identical to one from 3,000. Every figure carries the minutes behind it and a sample label saying how much weight that deserves. No player is excluded for playing too little.
principles.fit: A role score measures statistical resemblance to a profile. It is not a scouting grade, not a probability, and not a substitute for watching the player.

limitations.strength: A 90th percentile in one competition is not equivalent to a 90th percentile in another. No competition-strength coefficient is applied, because inventing one would be worse than stating the limitation.
limitations.marketTitle: Market value is not a transfer fee
limitations.market: Market values come from Transfermarkt and represent a crowd-sourced estimate. They are not asking prices, and no valuation model is applied on top of them.
